subject.title: [Feature]: [Feature Request] OpenClaw WebChat: Conversation Management & Multi-AI Collaboration

question: Should this remain the canonical broad WebChat conversation-management and multi-AI collaboration tracker, and which remaining pieces should OpenClaw core own versus plugins or narrower follow-up issues?
rationale: Current main implements a useful session-management subset, while the missing request defines durable product/API boundaries across WebChat UI, Gateway session metadata, project organization, and multi-agent orchestration.

options.title: Keep Canonical And Split Milestones
options.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella and require narrower maintainer-designed milestones for project/topic organization, protocol/storage support, and multi-model collaboration.

options.title: Narrow Core Scope
options.body: Limit OpenClaw core to session/project organization and route committee, meeting, consensus, and role workflows to plugin or RFC work unless a missing core API is proven.

options.title: Close After Transfer
options.body: Close this umbrella only after every remaining requirement is moved to clearly canonical narrower issues for projects, topic trees, and multi-agent collaboration.

recommendation.title: Keep Canonical And Split Milestones
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella and require narrower maintainer-designed milestones for project/topic organization, protocol/storage support, and multi-model collaboration.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete provided the canonical-tracker signal and recently authored adjacent session/sidebar work that partially implements the request.
